## Checklist

- [ ] Changes to observable output (pairs, analysis, report) update `spec/` and add or update a conformance case.
- [ ] The libraries that share the change are updated together, or the PR says which follow.
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header of their folder (`scripts/check-licenses.sh`).
- [ ] User-facing changes have an entry in the library's `CHANGELOG.md`.
